rapidyenc — vendored snapshot
=============================

Upstream:   https://github.com/animetosho/rapidyenc
Commit:     27f435afa0a3a15995001219beca08de29f87a0f (shallow clone, 2026-07-18)
Version:    1.1.1 (RAPIDYENC_VERSION 0x010101 in rapidyenc.h)

The .git directory (and .github/.gitignore) were removed — this is a plain
source snapshot, not a submodule.

License
-------
rapidyenc itself is **Public Domain, or CC0 (or equivalent) where public
domain is not recognised** (stated in README.md "License" section). This is
maximally permissive; no attribution or notice obligations.

Third-party components inside this tree:
- crcutil-1.0/ — Apache License 2.0 (see crcutil-1.0/LICENSE). NOTE: our
  build (crates/nzbkit/build.rs) compiles with YENC_DISABLE_CRCUTIL=1, so
  crcutil is NOT compiled into nzbfast binaries. It is only used by upstream
  as the generic CRC32 fallback on x86; rapidyenc has its own generic
  slice-by-4 fallback when crcutil is disabled. Directory kept for
  completeness / future re-enable.
- The CRC32 folding kernels (src/crc_folding*.cc) derive from zlib-ng
  (zlib license) per upstream README.

Build notes
-----------
Built by crates/nzbkit/build.rs using the `cc` crate (cmake is not installed
on this machine; the cc route replicates the per-file -march flags from
upstream CMakeLists.txt). Encoder is excluded (RAPIDYENC_DISABLE_ENCODE=1 and
encoder_*.cc not compiled) — we only need decode + CRC.

Pruned: nothing beyond the .git/.github metadata. The tree is small (~950 KB);
tool/ (CLI + bench sources, not compiled by us) and crcutil-1.0/ were kept.
